abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: An enhanced sensory system allows Daredevil to bypass Miss.

abilitySections.title: Entering the Fight
content: The Devil of Hell's Kitchen gains an indefinite Passive Combo Shield, preventing his Combo Meter from resetting when struck.

abilitySections.title: Fight Start
content: Base Regeneration Rate is set at 40% instead of the normal 100%.
Immune to all effects that modify Regeneration Rate, except Poison.

abilitySections.title: Murdock Boy - Combo Meter 15 or Lower
content: The unbreakable spirit of Battlin' Jack Murdock grants the following:

When inflicted with a non-damaging Debuff, one of each non-damaging Debuff is Purified after 0.5 seconds. Each time this ability triggers, Devil of H.K. gains +5 Combo Meter. This ability goes on Cooldown for 2 seconds once activated.
Passive +[4,125] Physical Resistance against Basic Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Stick's Apprentice - Combo Meter 16 or More
content: The assassin training of Stick grants the following:
+[1,178.57] Critical Rating.
Attacks reduce the opponent's Defensive Ability Accuracy by 65%.
+[2,615.5] Attack Rating for each Non-Damaging Debuff on the Devil of H.K. This bonus decreases by 5% for each additional Debuff.
When struck, 1 Combo Meter is lost.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit spends 10 Combo Meter to grant a 100% chance to gain a stacking Cruelty Buff, increasing Critical Damage Rating by +[563.25] for 14 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to boost Critical Rating by [916.67] for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit immediately loses any Combo Meter gained.
Each hit spends 5 Combo Meter to grant a 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, causing [13,077.5] direct damage over 5 seconds.
At the end of the attack, gain a Rage Debuff with no effect, lasting 12 seconds. When this Debuff ends, it is replaced with a Fury Buff, granting +[8,369.6] Attack rating for 25 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain a Righteous Wrath Passive for 70 seconds. While active, The Devil of H.K.'s basic attacks have a 35% chance to inflict an instant Bleed, causing 120% of the damage dealt by the attack as direct damage.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Sinner Or Saint
content: Murdock Boy: Exiting this mode has a 100% chance to grant a stacking [6 - 17] second Rage Debuff with no effect.
Stick's Apprentice: While in this mode, attacks reduce the damage of the Opponent's Passive Degeneration and Direct Damage effects by [50 - 100]% for 0.2 second(s).
